title: Hypothesis Card
description: A single, testable trading strategy hypothesis with an explicit edge-source declaration. Improvement 01 (A1.1-A1.3).

then.description: E-060 S3b: a composition run's card, written by code (step 1a composition pass-through, no LLM). A composite has no single edge source of its own: its blocks were each validated with theirs.

composition.description: E-060 S3b: the composition this card passes through (registry_hash, registry_revision, timeframe, timeframe_category, block_ids, manifest_ref). Present only on a composition run's code-written card.

thesis.description: One-sentence plain-English claim about why this strategy should work.

rationale.description: Market microstructure or behavioral reason supporting the thesis.

edge_source.description: Improvement 01: declares the structural reason this edge should exist. Must be populated BEFORE signal_concept.

category.description: The structural category of the edge.

specific_mechanism.description: A1.3: 1-2 sentences. Must name at least one measurable proxy in an available feed that looks different if the mechanism is real vs absent.

why_not_arbitraged.description: Why this edge persists. For persistent_behavioral_bias: must argue why bias survives at this timeframe/venue despite being publicly known.

evidence_type.description: A1.2: must match an available entry in config/available_feeds.yaml, OR requires_new_feed must be set and the hypothesis routes to feed_wishlist.yaml.

measurable_proxy.description: A1.3: the specific observable from an available feed that would look different if the mechanism is real vs absent. Becomes input to validation_protocol.falsifiable_statement.

requires_new_feed.description: A1.2: present when evidence_type is NOT in available_feeds.yaml. Names the feed needed. Hypothesis routes to feed_wishlist.yaml and MUST NOT enter the run queue.

signal_concept.description: Pseudo-formula or English description of the signal computation. Must be derivable from edge_source.measurable_proxy.

target_market.description: Symbol and conditions where the signal applies, including the regime condition if the idea has one.

assumptions.description: Falsifiable things that must be true for the signal to work.

expected_failure_modes.description: Pre-enumerated ways this hypothesis could fail. At least 3 required.

library_lookup.description: Improvement 04: result of indicator library lookup. Required before finalizing signal_concept.

power_parameters.description: A8.6: a-priori power parameters for automated power check before prescreen.

activation_rate.description: Fraction of bars where signal fires (e.g. 0.218 for F&G daily).

plausible_ic_upper.description: Literature upper bound for IC in this signal class (e.g. 0.15).

n_bars.description: Bars in test window (default: 17520 = 2 years at 1h).

is_market_wide.description: True if signal is a single market-wide index (F&G, VIX). Returns are correlated so n_symbols_effective = sqrt(n_symbols).

data_requirement.description: Stated data extension needed if power is insufficient.

criteria.description: E-056 Slice 3b IMPROVEMENT 07 (config-direct-authoring flow only): pre-registered pass/fail criteria picked from config/criterion_menu.yaml's live entries. Absent entirely, not empty, when that flow is not in use.

cost_feasibility.description: E-056 Slice 3b IMPROVEMENT 07 (config-direct-authoring flow only): relocated from quant-validation/SKILL.md's own Improvement 09. Same shape as validation_protocol.schema.json's cost_feasibility block.

pass_through.description: E-056 Slice 3b IMPROVEMENT 08 (config-direct-authoring flow only): true when this card's config/manifest/criteria/source were supplied upstream, already fully authored, and simply copied through rather than derived.

config.description: E-056 Slice 3b IMPROVEMENT 08 (pass_through candidates only): the fully-authored strategy config, copied verbatim from research_brief.yaml/an attached candidate block. CODE-REVIEW FIX (2026-09-21): added -- hypothesis-design/SKILL.md's IMPROVEMENT 08 instructs copying this field through, but additionalProperties:false would have rejected any card that did.

manifest.description: E-056 Slice 3b IMPROVEMENT 08 (pass_through candidates only): the block manifest, copied verbatim alongside config, then written by 1b as artifacts/block_manifest.yaml. Same fix as config above. E-056 1b block manifest (code-review fix 7): $ref's the block_manifest schema so a malformed pass-through manifest is caught at the card (shape only; resolution against the config is checked in code after 1b).

claim.description: E-068 slice 2 (CUL-389, orchestrator.claim_tests.enabled only; absent otherwise): the idea's claim and the test that could prove it false, composed from the slots in workflow_artifacts/skills/hypothesis-design/CLAIM_TESTS.md. The enforcing code is tools/claim_card.check_claim (slot rules: tools/claim_tests.check_spec); this schema documents the shape and tests/test_e068_s2_claim_card.py keeps the two in agreement.

statement.description: The claim in plain words a new joiner can read.

kind.description: Which question the claim answers (O-18's closed list). It says whether the idea could be a block; step 1b's block_manifest.yaml decides whether it is one, and of which kind.

tests.description: 1 to 3 tests composed from the four slots (the claim is supported only if every test passes), or the string "none" with missing_block. May be omitted only when criteria_refs is given.

criteria_refs.description: Ids of criteria in this card's own `criteria` list that test the claim (cost, redundancy, robustness kinds).

missing_block.description: With tests: none only: the building block the slots lack. Recorded (a row in campaign_record/test_requests.yaml); the run continues without a claim test.

pass_if.description: Plain words restating the code's verdict rule. Decides nothing.

fail_if.description: Plain words restating the code's verdict rule. Decides nothing.

rationale.description: Why these tests answer this claim.

source.description: E-056 Slice 3b IMPROVEMENT 08 (pass_through candidates only): names where the pass-through config/manifest/criteria originated (a human operator, or a prior campaign artifact). Same fix as config above.
